name: Contact
shortdesc: Contact form and private Admin inbox for PHP and SIPL.
longdesc: A public contact form with product topics, duplicate-safe submissions and spam limits, plus an Admin inbox with pagination and read/unread controls. Supports native PHP and SIPL handlers and tenant-scoped storage.
author: Robert Allen

name: Editor Demo
shortdesc: An isolated public editor demo for PHP and SIPL.
longdesc: All twelve CMS editor tools with temporary editing and reset. Runs as a separate plugin-owned service and survives CMS upgrades.
author: Robert Allen
